mechanism: Enalapril may potentiate oxybutynin's anticholinergic effects and both drugs can cause hypotension through different mechanisms, while oxybutynin's anticholinergic properties may reduce enalapril's effectiveness by decreasing GI motility and absorption.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for excessive anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation), and ensure adequate fluid intake; counsel on orthostatic precautions.
